scope: DoRobot Studio and Nexus Studio desktop JIT apps using iOS/iPad interaction and visual conventions. Each app must score at least 91 separately. Physical iPhone deployment, robot hardware and production training performance are outside this UI review.
reference: OctoSense fixed-rubric, real-input, original-pixel review process; Apple iOS/iPad conventions for hierarchy, navigation, touch-sized controls and continuity.
hard_gates: Every listed screen has original rendered evidence at both target sizes and appearances.
No essential action or editor is clipped or unreachable; scrolling and overflow actions work.
Core real-input journeys pass; unsupported hardware actions explain what is needed.
No UI shader errors or panics in the tested app paths.
Appearance and navigation preserve the active task; restart restores supported user state.
No private credentials, machine addresses, personal paths or user data in published evidence.

criteria: Recognizable iOS/iPad navigation and grouped content.
Clear current location and one obvious route back to the main task.
Primary work receives the available space.
Primary actions and navigation have at least 44-point hit targets.
Visible selected, disabled and pressed states.
Keyboard focus, Escape/cancel and primary shortcuts work.
Readable body type and distinct title/section hierarchy.
Secondary metadata remains readable.
Names and labels truncate or wrap deliberately.
Semantic iOS surfaces and restrained blue primary actions.
Light/dark works across content, controls and dialogs.
Normal text meets 4.5:1 contrast; large text 3:1.
Empty and error states explain a useful next step.
Controls describe user tasks without developer terminology.
Recording, playback, training and saved states are explicit.
No essential overlap at either tested size.
Narrow layouts adapt their panes.
Scroll boundaries keep controls reachable.
Selection and active data survive navigation and appearance changes.
Supported saved state is restored after relaunch.
Hidden UI work is reduced while legitimate jobs remain independent.
Both Studios use shared type, navigation and component conventions.
The same action has the same placement and behavior across screens.

anchors.0.8: Usable with visible deviations or an unobserved required state
anchors.0.9: Consistently iOS-like in observed states with minor defects
anchors.1.0: Matches the stated reference across all required observations

scoring: Score each dimension from 0 to 1 against cited evidence. Weighted sum is the app score. Missing required evidence caps the affected dimension at 0.8 and prevents completion. Report remaining defects and evaluator provenance; do not call model review independent human review.

studio: Open Nano dataset and select another episode
Play/pause, seek, step and return to start
Navigate away and back without losing the episode or position
Switch appearance without losing playback state or layout
Tag an episode, reopen and verify the tag
Open/cancel an input flow without losing the active task
Visit hardware/capture/evaluation unavailable states and follow their next action
Relaunch and verify supported preferences and selection
nexus: Open bundled Nano and inspect its joints/assets
Navigate all eight workspaces with selection retained
Switch appearance with the current robot/task retained
Inspect an empty run and unavailable training/deployment states
Filter a library and clear the filter
Relaunch and restore workspace, selection and appearance
